standard_prerequisites.name: Elements of ordinals are ordinals
standard_prerequisites.use: Last line of the proof (line 461): the in-least element found inside the ordinal alpha is itself an ordinal.

standard_prerequisites.name: Ordinals are well-ordered by membership
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The unit's standing facts on ordinals developed just above (section header line 443 states the induction schema and trichotomy are the reason ordinals are well-ordered by membership)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the existence of an in-least phi-element inside alpha in the Otherwise branch.

core_obligations: Contrapositive split (proof lines 457-458): assume phi(alpha); if every beta in alpha has not-phi, alpha itself is the minimal instance.
Least element inside alpha (lines 459-461): otherwise the members of alpha satisfying phi have an in-least element, which is an ordinal by the member-is-ordinal lemma, and it witnesses the claim.
proof_roadmap: Take an ordinal instance of phi.
If it is already minimal below it, done.
Otherwise pick the membership-least phi-ordinal inside it.

Two lines of case analysis on the assumed instance; the well-ordering of alpha's elements is inherited from the chapter's setup. H2: short schema with one internal citation.
